In the Unaudited standalone and consolidated Financial Results for the current quarter/year to date period, operating lease expenses has changed from rent to depreciation for the right of use of assets and finance cost for interest accrued on lease liability. The impact on account of adoption is not material for the current quarter/year. n3 Based on its initial assessment, the Management does not expect any significant impact on the business of the Company due to the COVID-19 pandemic.
